usage: icebath approvals [-h] <subcommand> ...

Tools for the dangerous-command approval system. `icebath approvals suggest` mines past approval
decisions from the session database and proposes command_allowlist entries so repeatedly-approved
commands stop prompting.

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    suggest     Propose command_allowlist entries from past approvals
    test        Dry-run the approval verdict for a command (never executes it)

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
